content: Thiabendazole is supplied in a liquid suspension form with a concentration of 5 grams per 5 milliliters, available in a 120 mL bottle. It should be stored in a well-closed container at controlled room temperature and must be protected from freezing. Mintazol chewable tablets, containing 500 mg of thiabendazole, are white to off-white in color, orange-flavored, round, scored, and compressed. These tablets are imprinted with MSD 907 on one side and MINTAZOL on the other. They are supplied in unit dose packages containing 36 individually sealed tablets, with the National Drug Code (NDC) 0006-0907-36.
